cleaner.label: Electron
cleaner.description: Downloaded Electron binaries and electron-builder tool cache. Does not touch projects or already packaged apps.

option.label: Downloaded Electron binaries
option.description: Removes the Electron archives downloaded by @electron/get.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next electron `npm install` or the next packaging.

option.label: electron-builder cache
option.description: Removes the tools that electron-builder downloads to package apps.
option.warning: Re-downloaded the next time electron-builder runs.
